ios.desc:
Just Listen is a simple podcast app for iPhone. This podcast player is designed for the 99% audio listeners instead of podcast veterans. 

We are the 99%. We care not a whit for podcast show subscription. We fear podcast/audio contents overload. We are tired of stereotyped podcast categories. We are sick of consuming too much similar content through recommendation algorithms. We need an intuitive way to discover podcasts. Just Listen, a free podcast app, brings serendipity to podcast discovery.

Explore your favorite podcasts in a creative and straightforward way:

• Episode oriented: expand your area of podcast listening. There are a lot of fabulous podcasts for you to discover, ranging from self-care and education, to comedy and music, to politics and cultures, to true crime and storytelling, and even more!

• One episode at a time: conquer audio overload. Don't let the long podcast playlist destroy your listening experience.

• A random episode every time: chance on different podcast episode that you didn't know you were interested. No need to regret if you miss some podcasts. You'll always find more interesting ones.

• Dismiss to discover: say goodbye to an uninteresting episode, you will discover a new one which is more likely to hit you. You can keep away from your disinterested episodes while avoiding to consume superfluously similar audio contents. Burst your cultural or ideological bubble, keep an open mind, and embrace democracy.

• Engage to better discover: the more you engage in Just Listen, the more you will discover your undiscovered interests. Discover your interested audio contents, and discover yourself. 

• Explore to the wild world of podcasts: access to 600,000 podcasts and 40,000,000 episodes. Just Listen. 

Let's experience the serendipity of your favorite podcast discovering in Just Listen! Download the podcast app, Just Listen, for free today!

Enjoy podcasts! Just Listen!
